title: Phase 2 Study Evaluating Apitegromab for the Treatment of FSHD
official: A Phase 2, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Multicenter, 52-Week Study Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of Apitegromab in Participants With Facioscapulohumeral Muscular Dystrophy (FORGE)
summary: Main objective: To assess the efficacy of apitegromab compared with placebo in participants with FSHD
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Able to comprehend the informed consent process and provide written informed consent prior to study enrollment and the conduct of any study-related assessments.
2. Able to adhere to the requirements of the protocol, including completing all study procedures and study visits.
3. Male or female participants, 18 to 60 years of age at the time of informed consent.
4. Genetic diagnosis of FSHD1 or FSHD2, confirmed with the appropriate documentation from an accredited laboratory.
5. Clinical severity score of 1.5 to 3.0 (Ricci score: range 0 to 5), inclusive, at screening.
6. Baseline 10MWRT time ≤5 seconds.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Any other medical condition or clinically significant laboratory result or ECG value that, in the opinion of the investigator, may compromise safety or compliance, would preclude the participant from successful completion of the study, or interfere with the interpretation of the results.
2. Pregnant or breastfeeding
3. History of alcoholism or illicit drug use (drugs that are illegal and have not been prescribed).
4. Contraindications for MRI that may include, but are not limited to, certain implanted electronic devices, cochlear implants, metallic foreign bodies, vascular clips, and metallic implants; or claustrophobia, contrast agent allergies, inability to lie still, or external medical devices that may not be removed
5. Prior history of a hypersensitivity reaction to a mAb or recombinant protein bearing an Fc domain (eg, a soluble receptor-Fc fusion protein), apitegromab, or excipients of apitegromab.
6. Any acute or comorbid condition interfering with the well-being of the participant within 7 days prior to screening, including active systemic infection, the need for acute treatment, or inpatient observation due to any reason.
7. Previous treatment with apitegromab, or with other anti-myostatin therapies, including activin receptor antagonists
8. Current or prior use of anabolic steroids, growth hormones, glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists, or other substances with known effects on muscle
9. Use of therapies with potentially significant muscle effects (eg, androgens, insulin-like growth factor, growth hormone, systemic beta-agonist, botulinum toxin, or muscle relaxants or muscle-enhancing supplements) or potentially significant neuromuscular effects (eg, acetylcholinesterase inhibitors) within 60 days before screening
10. Use of systemic or corticosteroids within 60 days prior to screening. Inhaled or topical steroids are allowed.
11. Taking medications that impede coagulation or platelet aggregation or has a history or active coagulopathy disorder.
12. Treatment with other investigational drugs in a clinical study within 3 months or 5 half-lives, whichever is longer, before screening.
